about: Hand labels for evaluating the link scanner (scripts/linkEval.ts) on the starter library: every phrase that resolved to a target in the sampled sections of octopus-minds, fixed-points, origin-of-the-elements and invention-of-writing (tuning set, first 16 sections of 40+ words each) and tuning-and-temperament (held out, first 12), plus a few clear misses marked added. 'yes' means a careful Wikipedia editor would link the phrase in that sentence (MOS:LINK: specific concepts, technical terms, names; not everyday words, partial phrases, wrong senses, or a document's central subject after its first mention), and target is the right article or library section, which may differ from the scanner's.
